workflow.content_utf8:
name: Demand-rooted inheritance source validation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      revision:
        description: 'Immutable source commit for inheritance, coercion and typed API gates'
        default: 'c7062ec91550590d5dedc790a736e13e333a5b17'
        required: true
        type: string
  push:
    branches: ['perf/compact-xaml-theme-codegen']
    paths: ['.github/workflows/winui-inheritance-source-validation.yml']

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: winui-inheritance-source-${{ github.ref }}-${{ inputs.revision || 'c7062ec91550590d5dedc790a736e13e333a5b17' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  source-validation:
    name: Actual inherited-change lifetimes, coercion and property registration
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          path: tooling
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.revision || 'c7062ec91550590d5dedc790a736e13e333a5b17' }}
          path: source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Native development dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential binutils curl xz-utils pkg-config time
      - name: Compile immutable source and run inheritance gates
        env:
          SOURCE_REVISION: ${{ inputs.revision || 'c7062ec91550590d5dedc790a736e13e333a5b17' }}
        run: |
          python3 tooling/scripts/themes/bench/run_winui_source_validation.py \
            --source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/source" \
            --revision "$SOURCE_REVISION" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/winui-inheritance-source-validation" \
            --suite inheritance \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::inheritance_tests::inherited_notification_matches_original_values_defaults_and_unwind \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::inheritance_tests::inherited_notification_matches_original_clone_equality_and_handler_reentry \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::inheritance_tests::inherited_notifications_keep_source_metadata_across_overrides_and_attached_hosts \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::inheritance_tests::explicit_inheritance_registration_and_opt_out_keep_public_behavior \
            --required-test tests::ferro_property_registry_tests::registered_properties_count_reflects_newly_added_attached_property \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::coercion_tests::recoercion_matches_original_owned_value_frames_and_unwind \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::coercion_tests::recoercion_matches_original_reentrant_reads_writes_and_priority_snapshots \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::coercion_tests::metadata_coercion_keeps_clone_only_api_and_callback_pair_lifetimes \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::coercion_tests::metadata_replacement_matches_original_callback_drop_unwind \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::coercion_tests::recoercion_keeps_nan_equality \
            --required-test ferro_property::styled_property_options_tests::registration_transfers_the_original_coercer \
            --required-test ferro_property_metadata::metadata_table_tests::colliding_cache_entries_follow_replaced_and_removed_registrations \
            --required-test ferro_property_metadata::metadata_table_tests::unregister_invalidates_inherited_and_relocated_overrides
      - name: Preserve commands, source, results and failure evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: winui-inheritance-source-validation-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/winui-inheritance-source-validation/evidence
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 1
          retention-days: 14

remaining_gates: Interaction gates against the separate combined source are pending.
Fresh matched full executable with original training/features/native policy is required for production claims.
Paired production workloads and the existing boxed-style throughput blocker remain open.
scope: Actual framework source gate for registered inherited-change dispatch, retaining coercion, property, metadata and registry coverage.
